name: Dull Cougar 87
author: WhiteNervosa
description: Green button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 0px -4px 0px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%), inset 0px 2px 0px 0px rgb(230 230 230 / 7%). On focus, box-shadow becomes inset 0px -4px 0px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%), inset 0px 2px 0px 0px rgb(230 230 230 / 7%).
